description: The twelve deployment gates. Status is computed from the repository by validate-azure --readiness, never declared here. A gate with no blocker is NO-BLOCKERS-FOUND, which is not an approval: every gate also needs the named approver. No gate authorises a deployment by itself, and production is never deployed automatically (HC-11).

gates.title: Azure design reviewed and approved
gates.evidence: An Approved design review record for the reference architecture, with the Well-Architected assessment and the ten review perspectives answered

gates.title: Residency established per port, with a hosting option
gates.evidence: Port register entry per port: legal basis, basis other than region, eight validations Verified with evidence

gates.title: Region and service capability verified live
gates.evidence: A recorded read-only check of each required service, SKU, feature and zone in the chosen region, in the approved subscription

gates.title: Identity, RBAC and key custody validated
gates.evidence: Registered approvers, scoped deployment identities, role assignments checked against the pinned list, key custody decision

gates.title: Infrastructure as code complete and validated
gates.evidence: Parameter files with approved values outside the secret path, bicep build and static policy checks clean, reviewed commit

gates.title: What-if and dependency plan reviewed
gates.evidence: A recorded what-if result per environment for the reviewed commit, with no unexpected delete

gates.title: Cost estimate sourced and budget set
gates.evidence: An estimate built from sourced unit prices and agreed volumes, a budget and alert contacts

gates.title: Approval recorded for resource creation and billable change
gates.evidence: A signed approval record bound to the reviewed commit, the scope and the environment
gates.approver: registered approvers (P3, and P4 where it applies)

gates.title: Operations, rollback and recovery ready
gates.evidence: Runbooks exercised in non-production, rollback and restore tested in the jurisdiction, support-access model agreed, recovery targets agreed
gates.approver: port operations and the site reliability owner

gates.title: Post-deployment smoke and integration tests defined and run
gates.evidence: A recorded run of the smoke and integration tests against the non-production deployment

gates.title: Tenant, subscription and environment separation decided
gates.evidence: D-037 decided; dev, test and prod in separate subscriptions or an equivalent recorded separation

gates.title: Phase raised by a human
gates.evidence: An ADR recording the human decision that raises the phase, and the phase value in command-policy.json
